decision.summary: Two regions warrant closer inspection: (1) a sharp, multi-axis jump near the end of the first window (indices 539–544), likely a step change or data artifact; (2) a prolonged period of elevated, correlated variability in E/U from ~680 to 729, suggestive of sustained motion or systematic error.

regions.observation: Abrupt large-magnitude jump in all three axes (N/E/U) around index 539–540, with values shifting from ~[-2, 3, -0.5] to ~[24, 18, 23], suggesting a permanent offset or data discontinuity; no clear return observed within window.

Sustained high-amplitude oscillatory behavior in E and U components from ~index 680 onward, with E fluctuating between ~20–26 and U between ~22–26, possibly indicating platform-like motion or persistent deformation; N shows less coherence but similar timing.
